Hi,

I am conducting a multiple group analysis with lavaan. When plotting the coefs with lavaanPlot, I´m getting in trouble with having no labels (like "Group1"/"Group2") plotted to the paths of the coefs.
Here is my code: 
lavaanPlot(model = fit, coefs = TRUE, sig = 1, stars="regress", covs = TRUE)

Thanks in advance!
